units: <cite ref="Shabbat 66b:12">Sabb. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>סחופי כסא אטיבורא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>אטיבורי</he>, <he>אטבורי</he>, corr. acc.) to put a dry cup on the navel.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:4:3">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>חיי מן טִיבּוּרְיֵיה</he> it draws nourishment through its navel string; <he>איפסיק טיבורייה</he> when its navel string is cut.
